message.content: {"distractor_3":"Provision an Azure Form Recognizer resource and train a custom model before opening the module exercise and launching the guided lab.","explanation_why_it_is_incorrect_3":"This exercise uses the prebuilt Azure AI Document Intelligence model; you don’t need to provision or train a custom model to run the guided lab.","thinking_process3":"Believable mistake: readers see \"Form Recognizer/Document Intelligence\" and assume they must create and train their own resource first. Provisioning and training a custom model is a valid step when building production solutions or custom extraction models, so it sounds like appropriate preparation. However, the Microsoft Learn exercise specifically uses a prebuilt model in a guided lab and only requires an Azure subscription with administrative access to launch it, so provisioning/training beforehand is unnecessary and wastes time."}
